'''Parsec''' was an [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force trooper]] [[Clone trooper officer/Legends|officer]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="CWA" /> which spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> As part of their [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] service, Parsec was stationed at a Republic outpost on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] planet of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. Parsec served as the "Felucia Entry Officer," under order to only allow those with enough combat experience to leave the outpost and enter the combat zone. As a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]]<ref name="CWA" /> created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Parsec was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Parsec wore green, camouflage ARF [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You'll need to rank up your Battle Class before running any missions here on Felucia.|Parsec|<ref name="CWA" />}}
Parsec appeared as a non-player character in the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. Parsec serves to block players who are not a high enough rank from entering the Felucia combat zone. When first talked to, Parsec gives the player the "Prepare for Felucia" mission requiring them to obtain a Battle Class rank of Sergeant 1, Adept 1, Apprentice 1, or Privateer 1.<ref name="CWA" />
